description.value: Nesters Market is a full-service Western Canadian supermarket chain founded in Whistler in 1987, now operated by the Pattison Food Group. The Kelowna Airport location offers a broad selection of fresh produce, deli and bistro prepared foods, in-store bakery, pharmacy, and a focus on local, organic, and natural products. It sits near the Kelowna Airport in a commercial area and caters to both locals and travelers passing through.
